title: webui file path truncates to 'T...' on widths up to 1100px
description: The file-meta span ("· N tasks · updated 5/21/2026, 2:35:17 AM") consumes the title row's space, so .bar .title strong with overflow:hidden ellipsis-collapses even when there's room. Repro: open webui at 320/375/414/480/640/768/1024 — TASKS.md becomes T...TASKS.... Suggested fix: stack title strong + file-meta in column flex when actions wrap (or below some min-width), or use a shorter file-meta. See tmp/responsive/{320,768,1024}.png.
